reason: I see the missed calls on my phone and call everyone back in the evening anyway, so I don't lose jobs. Paying 990 € up front plus 149 € every month for a text message I can send myself is nearly 2,800 € in the first year, and that is real money for a one-man shop.
objection: I don't believe it brings me a single extra job, I'd just be paying monthly for something I already do for free, and two founders with no customers yet might be gone in a year with my setup fee.
would_change_my_mind: No setup fee and around 30-40 € a month, or proof from another one-man trade business that it actually won them jobs they would have lost.
